plainText:
(Japanese: タツキ Tatsuki) is a Pokémon Trainer and a minor character who appeared in White—Victini and Zekrom and Black—Victini and Reshiram.

==In the movies==
He battled Iris's Emolga in a tournament in Eindoak Harvest Festival battle competition with his . Due to Emolga using to replace herself with Iris's Excadrill, Iris was disqualified from the tournament and Tatsuki was allowed to continue battling. Next, he went to battle where he faced his , and his Emboar was defeated by a powerful .

===Pokémon===
 

===Pokémon competitions===

===Artwork===
 

==In the manga==
Tatsuki appears in the of the fourteenth movie. He is only seen battling . Tatsuki sends out Emboar against Ash's Oshawott and was knocked out by an .

===Pokémon===
 

==Trivia==
Tatsuki is the only Trainer with a fully evolved Unova first partner Pokémon in White—Victini and Zekrom and Black—Victini and Reshiram to have battled another Trainer other than Ash.
He is also the only Trainer with a fully evolved Unova first partner Pokémon in M14 to win at least one battle in the tournament onscreen.
However, he only won when caused to be disqualified due to 's effect of switching out.
